boom.definitionKo: 어떤 사회 현상이 갑자기 유행하거나 크게 일어나 퍼지는 일.
boom.englishDescription: An instance in which a certain social phenomenon becomes suddenly popular, or flourishes and becomes widespread.

bourgeois.definitionKo: 중세 유럽에서, 도시에 거주하던 중산 계급의 시민.
bourgeois.englishDescription: In the middle ages in Europe, middle-class citizens residing in cities.

bourgeois.definitionKo: 근대 사회에서, 자본을 가지고 있는 계급에 속하는 사람.
bourgeois.englishDescription: A person who falls into a class possessing capital in a modern society.
(slang) A person who has a lot of money.

cafeteria.definitionKo: 손님이 자신이 주문한 음식을 직접 식탁으로 날라다 먹는 식당.
cafeteria.englishDescription: A restaurant where customers themselves take the food that they ordered  to their tables.

cinnamon.definitionKo: 녹나무에 속하는 나무의 껍질을 발효하여 말린 향신료.
cinnamon.englishDescription: A spice made by fermenting and drying the bark of a tree belonging to the camphor tree.

concrete.definitionKo: 토목 공사나 건축의 재료로 쓰는, 시멘트에 모래와 자갈을 섞어 물에 반죽한 물질.
concrete.englishDescription: Substance made by mixing cement, sand, and gravel and kneading the mixture with water, which is used in civil engineering projects or as construction material.

festival.englishDescription: A large-scale event held to celebrate something.

focus.definitionKo: 스포츠, 연극, 영화 등에서 가장 돋보이거나 흥미 있는 장면.
focus.englishDescription: The most outstanding or interesting scene in a sports game, theatrical play, movie, etc.

handsome.definitionKo: 주로 남자가, 체격이 좋거나 얼굴이 깔끔하게 잘생기다.
handsome.englishDescription: Usually used for men, being well-built and having a neat and attractive appearance.

interphone.definitionKo: 한 건물 안에서만 통화할 수 있는 유선 전화.
interphone.englishDescription: A wired telephone that can be used only within a building.

israel.definitionKo: 아시아 서쪽 지중해 연안에 있는 나라. 1948년에 영국의 팔레스타인 위임 통치가 끝나면서 유대인이 세운 나라로, 주변의 아랍 민족과 갈등이 있다. 주요 언어는 히브리어이고 수도는 예루살렘이다.
israel.englishDescription: A country located on the coast of the Mediterranean Sea in the west of Asia; it was founded by Jewish people after the British mandate for Palestine ended in 1948, and it has troubles with other Arabian peoples around it; its main language is Hebrew and its capital is Jerusalem.

kangaroo.definitionKo: 호주 및 그 주변의 여러 섬에서 살며, 암컷은 새끼를 낳아 배에 달린 주머니에 넣어서 기르는 동물.
kangaroo.englishDescription: An animal living in Australia and many of its surrounding islands, of which the female raises a baby in its pouch.

parcel.englishDescription: Goods packaged and sent as mail.

sketch.definitionKo: 단편 소설보다도 더 짧고 재치 있게 쓴 소설.
sketch.englishDescription: A witty novel, shorter than a novelette.
